audience: operators who keep customized agent launchers on a personal machine
agents that need a versioned, sanitized copy of those setups
future module authors adding Claude Code alternatives or other agent stacks
problem: Custom agent launchers live as one-off Desktop scripts. Without a registry, versions drift, secrets risk being copied into git, and another agent cannot tell which setup is current or where secrets are supposed to stay.
solution: A private modular registry that stores sanitized setup modules with temporal metadata (version, recorded_at, optional valid_time, source paths, status), starting with the Claude Code InferHub launcher.
mechanism: Index modules in registry.json with version and temporal fields
Keep each module under modules/<id>/ with module.json, files, and NOTES.md
Copy sanitized launchers only; document external .env locations for secrets
Adopt PCM for continuity and CGM for an evidence-bound README

evidence.claim: The repository is designed as a modular registry of custom agent setups with temporal and version metadata.
evidence.source: GitHub issue #1 design scope; registry.json and schemas in this repository.
evidence.supports: Establishes intended product shape: registry.json plus modules with version/recorded_at/status.
evidence.limits: Does not prove long-term adoption by other tools; only this scaffold exists so far.

source_revision.reference: Alex scaffolding request captured in issue #1

evidence.claim: The first module is a sanitized Claude Code InferHub launcher copied from Desktop configs.
evidence.supports: The module directory contains the launcher files and documents that secrets stay in Desktop/InferHub .env files.
evidence.limits: Does not claim the Desktop originals will stay identical; refresh requires a new module version bump.

evidence.claim: Narrative README marketing images are not generated on this machine yet.
evidence.supports: Documents that text-first README ships first and visuals are TBD.

boundaries: This repository never stores API keys, tokens, cookies, or .env contents.
Desktop configs remain the live personal source; this repo holds sanitized, versioned copies.
Narrative marketing images are TBD; the first README is text-first.
Do not call paid InferHub APIs from documentation or CI for this scaffold.

preferred.module: a versioned custom agent setup package
preferred.recorded_at: transaction time when the metadata was written
preferred.valid_time: optional period when the setup claim applies

avoid: stores your API keys safely in git
